I'll submit the patch now.

I have fixed the `TypeError` by removing the `algorithm="SAMME"` argument from the `AdaBoostClassifier` constructor in `churnmodel/factory.py`, as it is no longer supported in scikit-learn 1.9.1. I verified the fix with a reproduction script.

The issue was caused by the `algorithm` parameter in the `AdaBoostClassifier` constructor, which was removed in recent versions of scikit-learn (specifically from version 1.4 onwards). The `make_booster` function in `churnmodel/factory.py` was explicitly passing `algorithm="SAMME"`, leading to a `TypeError`.

I have removed the `algorithm="SAMME"` argument from the `AdaBoostClassifier` instantiation in `churnmodel/factory.py`. This restores functionality as the default behavior of `AdaBoostClassifier` now aligns with the previous "SAMME" implementation for the default base estimator.

Verified the fix with a reproduction script that successfully instantiates the booster without raising a `TypeError`.
